t: David borrowed ₹20,000 at 10% simple interest per annum. He made the following payments towards the loan: ₹4,000 after 1 year, ₹3,800 after 2 years, and the remaining amount after 3 years. The interest is charged on the reducing balance. What was the amount David paid as the final installment?

Total due after 1 year = ₹20,000 + ₹2,000 = ₹22,000
Payment made = ₹4,000
Remaining balance = ₹22,000 - ₹4,000 = ₹18,000
After 2nd Year:
Interest for 2nd year = 10% of ₹18,000 = ₹1,800
Total due after 2nd year = ₹18,000 + ₹1,800 = ₹19,800
Payment made = ₹3,800
Remaining balance = ₹19,800 - ₹3,800 = ₹16,000
After 3rd Year:
Interest for 3rd year = 10% of ₹16,000 = ₹1,600
Total due after 3rd year = ₹16,000 + ₹1,600 = ₹17,600
David paid ₹17,600 as the final installment.

t: A clock is sold for ₹550 cash or in the instalment scheme, for ₹250 cash down payment and ₹310 after one month. Find the rate of interest charged in the instalment scheme.
e:
Cash price = ₹550.
Instalment total = ₹250 (down payment) + ₹310 (after 1 month) = ₹560.
Extra amount paid = ₹560 - ₹550 = ₹10 (this is the interest).
Principal for interest is the remaining amount after down payment: ₹550 - ₹250 = ₹300.
Time = 1 month = 1/12 year.
Simple interest formula: I = PRT/100, where I = 10, P = 300, T = 1/12.
10 = (300 X R X 1/12) / 100.
10 = 300R / 1200.
10 = R / 4.
R = 40%.
Option (a) is the correct answer.
h: एक घड़ी 550 रुपये नकद या किश्त योजना में बेची जाती है, 250 रुपये नकद अग्रिम भुगतान और एक महीने बाद 310 रुपये। किश्त योजना में ली जाने वाली ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: In 10 years under simple interest, a sum of money becomes 5 times of itself. If the rate of interest per annum was increased by 20% but the time remains constant, then the same sum of money would fetch Rs. 160 more. In how many years, the same sum of money will fetch a total simple interest of Rs. 1500?
e:
Let the principal = P
Amount at the end of 10 years = 5P
SI = 5P - P = 4P
We know that,
SI = P*R*T/100
=> 4P = P*R*10/100
=> R = 40%
New rate of interest per annum = (100 + 20)% of 40 = 120% of 40 = 1.2*40 = 48%
Simple interest @ 48% per annum = P*48*10/100 = 4.8P
According to the question, 4.8P - 4P = 0.8P = 160
=> P = 200
Also,
1500 = 40*T*200/100
=> 80T = 1500
=> T = 150/8 = 18.75 years = 18 years 9 months
h: साधारण ब्याज के तहत 10 वर्षों में एक धनराशि अपने आप से 5 गुना हो जाती है। यदि प्रति वर्ष ब्याज दर में 20% की वृद्धि की जाए लेकिन समय स्थिर रहे, तो वही धनराशि 160 रुपये अधिक प्राप्त करेगी। कितने वर्षों में वही धनराशि 1500 रुपये का कुल साधारण ब्याज प्राप्त करेगी?

t: Manoj deposited Rs 22000 in SBI which offers simple interest @ 6% per annum. If Manoj withdrew Rs 10000 at the end of each 1<sup>st</sup> and 2<sup>nd</sup> year respectively then what is the total amount that Manoj will get at the end of 3<sup>rd</sup> year?

Interest during 1st year = Rs (22000 X 6/100) = Rs 1320
Principal amount for 2nd year = Rs (22000 - 10000) = Rs 12000
Interest during 2nd year = Rs (12000 X 6/100) = Rs 720
Principal amount during 3rd year = Rs (12000 - 10000) = Rs 2000
Interest during 3rd year = Rs (2000 X 6/100) = Rs 120
Total amount that Manoj would get at the end of the third year = Rs (22000 + 1320 + 720 + 120 - 10000 - 10000) = Rs 4160

t: A person wants to buy a laptop. The laptop is priced at ₹1500 if paid in full upfront. Alternatively, the person can make a down payment of ₹350 and pay the remaining amount in three equal monthly installments of ₹400 each. Calculate the rate of simple interest charged on the installment plan.
e:
Total amount paid in instalments = 3 * 400 = Rs.1200
Total amount paid = 350 + 1200 = Rs.1550
Interest paid = 1550 - 1500 = Rs.50
Principal for the 1st month = (1500 - 350) = Rs.1150
Principal for the 2nd month = (1150 - 400) = Rs.750
Principal for the 3rd month = (750 - 400) = Rs.350
Total principal for one month = 1150 + 750 + 350 = Rs.2250
SI = P * R * T/100
50 = 2250 * R * 1/1200
R = 26.66%

t: An article is available for Rs.2500 cash for Rs.520 cash down payments followed by 4 equal monthly Instalments. if the rate of interest is 25% per annum, calculate the monthly Instalment?
e: Cash price = 2500 Downpayment = 520 Remaining amount = 2500 – 520 = 1980 Rate = 25% Let each Instalment be Rs x, then, Amt. paid = 4 x Interest paid = 4 x – 1980 Considering time to be 1 month, principal will be, (1980) + (1980 – x ) + (1980 – 2 x ) + (1980 – 3 x ) Now, P = 1980 × 4 – 6x = 7920 – 6x R = 25% , T = 1 month, Int. = 4x – 1980
h: एक वस्तु 2500 रुपये नकद और 520 रुपये नकद डाउन पेमेंट के बाद 4 समान मासिक किश्तों पर उपलब्ध है। यदि ब्याज की दर 25% प्रति वर्ष है, तो मासिक किश्त की गणना कीजिए?

t: The rate of simple interest for first 2 years is 7.5% per annum, for the next 4 years it is 10% per annum and for the period beyond this, it is 14%. If the simple interest for 10 years is Rs. 493.95, what is the principal?
e:
Let the principal be Rs. 100.
SI on Rs. 100 for the first 2 years = 2 * 7.5 = Rs. 15
SI on Rs. 100 for the next 4 years = 4 * 10 = Rs. 40
SI on Rs. 100 for the further next 4 years = 4 * 14 = Rs. 56
Total SI = 15 + 40 + 56 = Rs. 111
If SI is Rs. 111 then principal = Rs. 100
If SI is Rs. 493.95 then principal = 100 * 493.95/111 = Rs. 445
h: पहले 2 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज की दर 7.5% प्रति वर्ष है, अगले 4 वर्षों के लिए यह 10% प्रति वर्ष है और इससे आगे की अवधि के लिए यह 14% है। यदि 10 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज रु. 493.95 है, तो मूलधन कितना है?

t: At simple rate of interest, Reena invested 30% of a sum at 20% per annum and rest of the sum at R% per annum. In 5 years, total interest received by her is 72% the sum invested. What is the value of R?
e: Simple interest = sum * rate * time/100 Total simple interest received = simple interest received on 30% of the sum at 20% per annum for 5 years + simple interest received on 70% of the sum at R% per annum for 5 years 72% of sum = (30% of sum) * 20 * 5/100 + (70% of sum) * R * 5/100 72/100 = 3/10 + 7R/200 42/100 = 7R/200 R = 12
h: साधारण ब्याज दर पर, रीना ने 30% राशि को 20% प्रति वर्ष की दर से तथा शेष राशि को R% प्रति वर्ष की दर से निवेश किया। 5 वर्षों में, उसे प्राप्त कुल ब्याज निवेश की गई राशि का 72% है। R का मान क्या है?

h: एक व्यक्ति ने अपने पुत्र, पुत्री और अपनी पत्नी के नाम से साधारण ब्याज पर 105750 रुपये की धनराशि इस तरह निवेश किया कि उन्हें क्रमश: 3, 4 और 5 वर्ष के बाद समान ब्याज प्राप्त होता है। यदि ब्याज की दर 5% प्रति वर्ष है, तो पत्नी के लिए निवेश की गई धनराशि _______ है।

t: A lender lends his Rs. 30000 to his friend. The rate of simple interest is such that it increases by 1% point after every year. The rate of interest at the time the loan was taken is 5% per annum. If the loan was taken for 8 years, then what is the amount received by the lender at the end of 8 years?
e:
Interest rate is increasing by 1% point after every year.
So, the interest rate for each year will be (5%, 6%, ....., 12%).
Effective interest rate for 8 years = (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 9 + 10 + 11 + 12) = 68%
Amount received by the lender at the end of 8 years = 30000 + 30000*68/100 = Rs. 50400
h: एक ऋणदाता अपने मित्र को 30000 रुपये उधार देता है। साधारण ब्याज की दर ऐसी है कि यह हर साल 1% बढ़ जाती है। ऋण लेने के समय ब्याज की दर 5% प्रति वर्ष थी। यदि ऋण 8 वर्षों के लिए लिया गया था, तो 8 वर्षों के अंत में ऋणदाता को कितनी राशि प्राप्त हुई?

t: A certain sum is invested for certain time at simple interest. It amounts to Rs 200 at 12% per annum. But when invested at 4% per annum, it amounts to Rs 100. Find the time?
e:
A certain sum is invested for certain time. It amounts to Rs X at P% per annum. But when invested at Q% per annum, it amounts to Rs Y.
Then the time = [(X-Y)/(YP-XQ)]*100
Here X = Rs 200, Y = Rs 100, P = 12%, Q = 4%
So time = [(200-100)/(100*12-200*4)]*100
Time = (100/400)*100 = 25 years
h: एक निश्चित धनराशि एक निश्चित समय के लिए साधारण ब्याज पर निवेश की गई| 12% प्रति वार्षिक दर से यह धनराशि 200 रुपये है| लेकिन जब इसे 4% प्रति वार्षिक दर से निवेश किया जाता है, तो यह धनराशि 100 रुपये होती है| समय ज्ञात करें?

t: A person wants to buy a house worth ₹7,50,000. He opts for a financing option where he makes a down payment and the remaining amount is financed with a simple interest rate of 10% per annum. The loan is to be repaid in 20 equal annual installments of ₹50,000. How much is the down payment made for the house?
e:
Total amount paid = 20 x 50000 = Rs.1000000
Let the principal amount be Rs.P
Total amount paid = Principal + SI
1000000 = P + SI
1000000 = P + (P x 10 x 20/100)
P = 1000000/3
P = Rs. 333333.33
Down payment = House price - Principal amount
Down payment = 750000 - 333333.33 = Rs.416666.67
h: एक व्यक्ति 7,50,000 डॉलर मूल्य का घर खरीदना चाहता है। वह एक वित्तपोषण विकल्प चुनता है, जिसमें वह डाउन पेमेंट करता है और शेष राशि 10% प्रति वर्ष की साधारण ब्याज दर से वित्तपोषित होती है। ऋण को 50,000 डॉलर की 20 बराबर वार्षिक किस्तों में चुकाया जाना है। घर के लिए डाउन पेमेंट कितना है?

t: If ₹1,875 becomes ₹2,625 in 4 years, what will ₹24,000 become at the end of 9 years at the same rate of interest, under simple interest?
e:
We know that S.I =P*R*T/100
As Rs.1875 becomes 2625 in 4 years,
So interest = 2625 - 1875 =Rs 750
So 1875*R*4/100 =750
R=75000/(1875*4)=10%
Now for Rs 24000 at the end of 9 years, we get:-
24000*10*9/100 =Rs 21600
So Amount = 21600 + 24000= Rs 45600
Option (a) is the correct answer.

Interest obtained after 4 years = (22000 * 15 * 2)/100 = Rs. 6600
Total amount of interest received after 4 years = 2000+6600 = Rs. 8600

t: A sum of Rs. 5000 amounts to Rs. 9400 in 4 years at (r + 8)% rate of simple interest. Find the interest obtained on Rs. 7500 at r% rate of simple interest after 2 years.
e:
Interest obtained = 9400 - 5000 = Rs. 4400
According to question,
4400 = [5000 * (r + 8) * 4]/100
=> r + 8 = (4400 * 100)/(5000 * 4)
=> r + 8 = 22
=> r = 14
Interest obtained on Rs. 7500 at r% rate of simple interest = (7500 * 14 * 2)/100 = Rs. 2100
h: 5000 रुपए की राशि साधारण ब्याज की (r + 8)% दर से 4 वर्ष में 9400 रुपए हो जाती है। 2 वर्ष बाद साधारण ब्याज की r% दर से 7500 रुपए पर प्राप्त ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A sum of ₹36,000 is divided into two parts, A and B, such that the simple interest at the rate of 15% p.a. On A and B after two years and four years, respectively, is equal. The total interest (in ₹) received from A is:
e:
Let the invested amount in scheme A and B is 'x' and '36000 - x' respectively.
According to the question:
(x * 15 * 2)/100 = [(36000 - x) * 15 * 4]/100
x = 72000 - 2x
x = 24000

t: A certain sum of money is given at a certain rate of simple interest for 6 years. Had it been given at 7% higher rate, it would have fetched ₹1,512 more. Find the sum (in ₹).
e:
Let the sum be P.
SI for increased rate = ₹1,512
Increased rate = (Rate + 7)%
Difference in SI = (P X 7 X 6) / 100
=> ₹1,512 = (P X 42) / 100
=> 1512 = 0.42P
=> P = 1512 / 0.42
=> P = 3600

307.2t = 1536
t = 5 years

t: If 'M' is the simple interest on 'N' and 'N' is the simple interest on 'P' then what is the relation between M, N and P? (Interest rate and time period is same in both the cases.)
e:
According to the question,
M = (N X R X T)/100
=> (R X T)/100 = M/N ..... (1)
Also,
N = (P X R X T)/100
=> (R X T)/100 = N/P ..... (2)
From (1) and (2), we get -
N<sup>2</sup> = MP
h: यदि 'M', 'N' पर साधारण ब्याज है और 'N', 'P' पर साधारण ब्याज है, तो M, N और P के बीच क्या संबंध है? (ब्याज दर और समय अवधि दोनों मामलों में समान है।)

t: If A, B, and C are three amounts of money such that B is the simple interest on A, and C is the simple interest on B, all for the same time and at the same rate of interest, then which of the following relations is always true?
e:
Using formula, SI = (P×R×T)/100
B = (A×R×T)/100 (i)
C = (B×R×T)/100 (ii)
Dividing equation (i) by (ii) we get
B/C = A/B
B² = AC
h: यदि A, B और C तीन धनराशियाँ इस प्रकार हैं कि B, A पर साधारण ब्याज है और C, B पर साधारण ब्याज है—और यह सब समान समय और समान ब्याज दर पर है—तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संबंध सदैव सत्य है?

समीकरण (i) को (ii) से भाग देने पर हमें प्राप्त होता है:

B² = AC

t: A sum of 28600 is lent out at 6.2% per annum simple interest for 10 years. What will be amount after 10 years?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) Rs. 46332 → ends in 2; (b) Rs. 38556 → ends in 6; (c) Rs. 36599 → ends in 9; (d) Rs. 44520 → ends in 0.
The exact value works out to Rs. 46332 (see Solution 2), ending in 2 — only option (a) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

SI = (P×R×T)/100 = (28600×6.2×10)/100 = ₹17,732
Amount = P+SI = 28600+17732 = ₹46,332 → option (a).
h: 28600 की राशि 6.2% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज पर 10 वर्षों के लिए उधार दी जाती है। 10 वर्ष बाद कितनी राशि होगी।

t: The rate of simple interest for first two years is 8% p.a., for the next 4 years, it is 10% p.a. and for the period beyond 6 years, it is 12% p.a. If a person gets Rs 18358.60 as simple interest after 9 years, then how much money (in Rs) did he invest?
e:
Total effective rate over 9 years = (8×2)+(10×4)+(12×3) = 16+40+36 = 92%. Principal = SI × 100/92 = 18358.60 × 100/92 = ₹19,955.

SI = P × 92/100 (since total % accumulated over 9 years = 92%, as shown above). 18358.60 = P × 0.92 → P = 18358.60/0.92 = 19,955. Breaking the 9 years into 2+4+3 year slabs and summing their rate-contributions first avoids three separate SI calculations.
h: पहले दो वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज की दर 8% प्रति वर्ष है, अगले 4 वर्षों के लिए यह 10% प्रति वर्ष है और 6 वर्ष से अधिक की अवधि के लिए यह 12% प्रति वर्ष है। यदि किसी व्यक्ति को 9 वर्षों के बाद साधारण ब्याज के रूप में 18358.60 रुपये मिलते हैं। तो उसने कितना पैसा (रुपये में) निवेश किया?

t: A person invested ₹54,500 at 12% p.a. simple interest for 2 years. Find the amount (in ₹) received after 2 years.
e:
SI for 2 years at 12% = 24% of principal ≈ 13,080; adding to principal (54500) gives about 67,580, matching option (d).

SI = (54500×12×2)/100 = 13080. Amount = 54500+13080 = 67580.
h: किसी व्यक्ति ने ₹54,500 का निवेश 12% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज की दर पर 2 वर्षों के लिए किया है। 2 वर्ष बाद उसे प्राप्त होने वाला मिश्रधन (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
